name: Compute Cluster S23: Portfolio Optimizers
description: Tests: inv_vol_weight, risk_parity, risk_budgeting, min_variance, max_sharpe, max_diversification, min_cvar, min_semivariance, hrp(linkage=all 7), herc(linkage=all 7, risk_measure=variance/vol), black_litterman. Full portfolio optimization coverage.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S23: Portfolio Optimizers
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

ret = returns(close)

# === SIMPLE WEIGHTING ===
vol_21 = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)
active = close > 0
w_iv = inv_vol_weight()(active, vol_21)
w_rp = risk_parity(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_rb = risk_budgeting(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)

# === MEAN-VARIANCE FAMILY ===
w_mv = min_variance(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_ms = max_sharpe(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_md = max_diversification(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_mc = min_cvar(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_msv = min_semivariance(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)

# === HRP: All 7 linkage methods ===
w_hrp_avg = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.average, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_hrp_cen = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.centroid, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_hrp_com = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.complete, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_hrp_med = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.median, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_hrp_sin = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.single, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_hrp_war = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.ward, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_hrp_wei = hrp(linkage=LinkageMethod.weighted, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)

# === HERC: All 7 linkage + 2 risk_measure ===
w_herc_avg_var = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.average, risk_measure=RiskMeasure.variance, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_herc_com_vol = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.complete, risk_measure=RiskMeasure.vol, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_herc_sin = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.single, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_herc_war = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.ward, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_herc_med = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.median, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_herc_cen = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.centroid, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)
w_herc_wei = herc(linkage=LinkageMethod.weighted, lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)

# === BLACK-LITTERMAN ===
w_bl = black_litterman(lookback=126, step_size=21)(ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='Inv Vol / Risk Parity Weights',
    category='Portfolio'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=w_iv)

cs_lines(
    title='Max Sharpe Weights',
    category='Portfolio'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=w_ms)

cs_lines(
    title='HRP (Ward) Weights',
    category='Portfolio'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=w_hrp_war)

cs_lines(
    title='HERC (Average, Variance) Weights',
    category='Portfolio'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=w_herc_avg_var)
